text:
Maria: Hey team — PR #14321 is ready for final eyes. It's the canary rollout for the routing fallback logic (runtime routing -> cheaper quantized variant when overloaded). Need: runtime approval for behavior, infra for canary schedule, security quick signoff for the rollout config. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/14321

Jon: taking a look now. Quick Q — does the fallback preserve token-level tracing headers? we rely on those for cost attribution.

Maria: @Jon yes, headers are preserved. I added a small shim in router.go to copy tracing metadata into the fallback request. snippet:
```go
// copy tracing headers if present
for k, v := range req.Headers {
  if strings.HasPrefix(k, "x-trace-") {
    fallbackReq.Headers[k] = v
  }
}
```

Jon: nice. will comment on a tiny nil-check but otherwise LGTM from runtime.

Sophia: infra question — canary needs a 4h ramp window in prod-us-east-1 (we want linear 1->50% over 4h). Any kube changes or new config maps?

Maria: no kube api changes, just a new rolloutPolicy config under the router feature flag. example config:
```yaml
rolloutPolicy:
  mode: canary
  duration: 4h
  steps: [10, 25, 50]
```
I'll add deployment steps to the PR description.

Sophia: that works. I'll schedule the canary for 09:00 UTC tomorrow if security signs off.

Kevin: security quick note — ran the CI SAST and dependency scan on the branch. No critical findings but we need to ensure the new config is encrypted at rest (secrets or KMS integration). Are any secrets being added?

Maria: no new secrets. The rolloutPolicy is plain config. We already store sensitive keys in KMS; this change only references existing KMS keys. CI attach: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/14321/sast — it says CLEAN.

Kevin: saw the report, okay from my side as long as deployment uses existing KMS role (no new IAM). Approving security.

Jon: pushed one tiny comment earlier, otherwise runtime approves.

Sophia: infra approves, scheduled 09:00 UTC tomorrow, will watch initial step.

Maria: awesome — thanks all. I'll merge after Jon's small fix is in and kick off the canary. @deploy-bot please schedule canary for 09:00 UTC tomorrow for pr-14321. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: pr-14321 -> prod-us-east-1 @ 09:00 UTC (4h ramp). Track: https://deploys.redwood-inference/internal/ops/14321

Maria: tagging this thread for follow-up post-canary results. cheers! :party_popper:
